text:
mira: Quick heads-up — during qint8 bring-up for new-model-v2 I spotted a consistent quality drop on several non-western language prompt variants (short QA + polite/formal register). Can someone spare a few mins to run a focused multilang promptset audit against the golden/holdout? posting a couple of failing snippets below for context. :eyes;

devon: I saw similar on the Spanish + Portuguese short-dialog shards, plus some diacritics mangled on longer contexts. Might be tokenizer/quant mismatch or special-casing in beam rescoring. I can triage tokenization diffs if someone prepares a small CSV of examples to repro.

aj: I can run a quick batch overnight. Can you point me to the sample list you want? I have a script that will run the model variants and produce per-example delta and log probs. usage: `./tools/run_eval_batch.sh --model new-model-v2-qint8 --input examples.csv --out /tmp/qint8-audit.jsonl`

mira: @aj thanks — I pushed a sample set to s3://redwood-curation/qint8-onboard/multilang-sample.csv (200 rows, balanced by locale). please run with `--max-len 512` and include `--save-kv-diff` so we can check kvcache effects.

labelops-bot: labeler queue status: current backlog 380, ETA to clear high-priority batch ~48h. If you need manual relabeling sooner, use the micro-golden flow (request via /labelops) and set priority=urgent.

tara: For dedupe — FYI that sample set contains ~12 near-duplicates (tokenhash fuzz > 0.87). Recommend running `tools/dedupe/fuzzy_dedupe.py --threshold 0.85` before sending to labelers, otherwise labellers will hit repeat cases. Also, we should mark 20 examples as holdout/golden candidates so we don't accidentally overwrite gold when we update.

devon: Agree on dedupe. I'll run a quick tokenizer diff and drop near-duplicates. Also will add a small analysis script to show tokenization shifts between fp16 and qint8 so we can tell if it's an encoding loss vs model behavior.

aj: Started run at 2023-05-21T02:04Z (kicking off with the s3 sample). Expect ~3h for full sweep, will post delta metrics and top 10 regressions. Command used: `./tools/run_eval_batch.sh --model new-model-v2-qint8 --input s3://redwood-curation/qint8-onboard/multilang-sample.csv --max-len 512 --save-kv-diff --out /artifacts/qint8-audit-1715000001.jsonl`

mira: Great. Once aj posts results let's convene for a 20m sync. Main decisions: (1) is this a quant-only regression (fix quant kernels / calibration), (2) do we need a small golden refresh (20-50 examples) to capture new failure modes, or (3) roll back to int8-lite variant for affected locales while we investigate.

labelops-bot: Reminder: to request micro-golden refresh, submit a ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/MLC-3248 with label `micro-golden` and include `samples_s3_path`.

tara: If we do a golden refresh, I'm happy to coordinate the labeler batch (will allocate a micro-goldlet). If queue is slow we can use the contractor pool for 24h turnaround (need PO approval).

devon: One quick note — tokenization diffs I saw were subtle: punctuation attachment on Khmer/Thai had +1 token in qint8 run for some cases (likely different whitespace handling in compiled tokenizer). Will attach short diff in thread.

aj: run finished — uploading artifacts: /artifacts/qint8-audit-1715000001.jsonl and a small report: /artifacts/qint8-audit-1715000001-summary.md. Top regressions look concentrated in ja, es, th, km. Posting short extract: 
example_id: 138 | locale: ja | fp16_score: -12.3 | qint8_score: -18.7 | delta: -6.4 | notes: polite form truncated, missing respectful suffix

mira: Thanks @aj. devon, can you post the tokenizer diff and the dedupe output (list of removed example_ids)? I'll take first pass at deciding golden candidates once we have those.

devon: Uploading tokenizer diffs to the ticket now and running `fuzzy_dedupe` — will post list in ~15m.

tara: If we pick golden refresh, propose we pick 25 examples across the top 4 affected locales (5-8 per locale) and run micro-golden. That should cover the most common failures without large labelling cost.

mira: Sounds good. Plan: devon posts dedupe & token diff, I pick 25 golden candidates, tara schedules micro-golden if needed, aj will re-run qint8 post-patch. If we still fail, then rollback plan. Meeting in 30m if anyone can join for quick decision. :thumbsup;
